summary: CBIZ, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Viking ParentCo and its wholly owned subsidiary Viking MergerCo. Under the deal, each CBIZ share will be converted into the right to receive $55.00 in cash. The board unanimously approved the merger and recommends stockholders adopt it. The merger will result in CBIZ becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, taking the company private. Stockholders may exercise appraisal rights under Delaware law. Key terms include equity award treatment and Marcum performance share provisions. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory approvals; risk-arb spread reflects deal certainty and timeline.
